name: dsh-time-context
description: Proactive time awareness for DeepSeek Harness: injects the current local time into the model context through the systemPrompt runtime context (change-only appends, KV-cache friendly) plus a short relative-time rule section. Pure config; zero business vocabulary.

dshCompatibility.note: deepseek-harness is pre-release with no compatibility promise; re-verify against newer commits before upgrading. The runtime context and section APIs are pinned to the harnessCommit above; no npm dependencies.
